nodes.label: Keep React 19 and Update Guidance
nodes.rationale: Starter already declares React 19 and matching type packages; updating guidance is lower risk than downgrading to React 18, which would move away from the imported starter snapshot and create dependency churn.

nodes.label: Use Vitest with React Testing Library for Unit Smoke Coverage
nodes.rationale: RTL + jsdom gives a realistic way to test React behavior; Vitest alone would satisfy a dependency checkbox but leave no clear component testing pattern.
nodes.norm_label: use vitest with react testing library for unit smoke coverage

nodes.label: Use Playwright with Automatic Dev-Server Startup
nodes.rationale: Validates the actual browser app including Vite, routing basename behavior, Tailwind rendering, and starter UI wiring; providing dependencies without a test would leave adopters to discover server/base URL setup themselves.
nodes.norm_label: use playwright with automatic dev-server startup

nodes.label: Keep ESLint and Prettier Separate
nodes.rationale: Avoids formatter rules turning ordinary lint runs into formatting failures; integrating Prettier into ESLint would add noise and extra plugin dependencies.

nodes.label: Add a Thin Power Apps Telemetry Scaffold
nodes.rationale: Initializes an ILogger via @microsoft/power-apps/telemetry's initializeLogger without requiring an Application Insights connection string or direct trackEvent API, since those are not exposed by the inspected package types; wiring applicationinsights-web directly was rejected as conflicting with Power Apps runtime ownership.
nodes.norm_label: add a thin power apps telemetry scaffold

nodes.label: Use a Centered README Identity Block
nodes.rationale: A centered logo, tagline, value statement, and badges give new visitors context before setup details; a plain heading with badges underneath would miss the open-source identity signal.
nodes.norm_label: use a centered readme identity block

nodes.label: Use Shields.io Badges for Public Trust Signals
nodes.rationale: Dynamic badges for release, stars, license, and npm version are easier to maintain and avoid stale metadata compared to static badge images checked into the repo.
nodes.norm_label: use shields.io badges for public trust signals

nodes.label: Add a Small SVG Icon Under media/
nodes.rationale: SVG keeps the asset small, readable, and easy to update without binary tooling, versus WebP/PNG which are more polished but less convenient for early iteration.
nodes.norm_label: add a small svg icon under media/

nodes.label: Add Standard Community Files
nodes.rationale: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md and CONTRIBUTING.md as separate files are recognized by GitHub's repository sidebar and issue/PR surfaces, unlike contribution notes folded only into the README.

nodes.label: Keep OpenSpec as an Explicitly Swappable Implementation Choice
nodes.rationale: States CodeSpec uses OpenSpec today for its low learning curve and reviewable project-local artifacts, not as permanent lock-in; presenting OpenSpec as fixed identity was rejected as conflicting with the long-term direction.
nodes.norm_label: keep openspec as an explicitly swappable implementation choice

nodes.label: Use create-codespec as the Package and Bin Name
nodes.rationale: create-* better signals an npm initializer and matches usage through npx, versus a plain 'codespec' bin name.
nodes.norm_label: use create-codespec as the package and bin name

nodes.label: Rename the Executable File to Match the Binary
nodes.rationale: Renaming to bin/create-codespec.js avoids confusing project identity in source paths and verification output, versus keeping the old filename with a new bin key.
nodes.norm_label: rename the executable file to match the binary

nodes.label: Preserve Platform Names, Not Old Project Identity
nodes.rationale: Legacy initializer/repository/package fallback references should be renamed, while Power Apps Code Apps, pac code init, and microsoft/PowerAppsCodeApps references describe the app platform and upstream source, not this initializer's name, and must remain.
nodes.norm_label: preserve platform names, not old project identity

nodes.label: Treat the Command Rename as Breaking
nodes.rationale: No legacy bin alias is kept; a compatibility alias would reduce friction for early users but would preserve the old name in package metadata and contradict the goal to rename before publishing.
nodes.norm_label: treat the command rename as breaking

nodes.label: Rename OpenSpec Capability Identity During Implementation
nodes.rationale: The active spec should live under openspec/specs/codespec-initializer/, moving (not copying) the capability directory to avoid duplicate specs, while preserving archive dates and historical meaning.

nodes.norm_label: add starter ci security workflows – change metadata

nodes.label: Add Starter CI Security Workflows – Design
nodes.norm_label: add starter ci security workflows – design

nodes.label: Store Workflow Templates in the GitHub Overlay
nodes.rationale: templates/github/workflows/ aligns workflow delivery with the existing prompt/skill overlay that the initializer already copies into .github, versus splitting .github ownership across starter and overlay.
nodes.norm_label: store workflow templates in the github overlay

nodes.label: Keep GHAS Checks in ghas.yml
nodes.rationale: Separate GHAS-specific permissions, scheduling, and Security tab behavior are easier to reason about than combining GHAS and quality checks into one workflow.

nodes.label: Use quality.yml for Free Local and GitHub-Native Checks
nodes.rationale: Weekly drift scanning is limited to drift-sensitive jobs (Semgrep OSS, npm advisories, Scorecard) rather than rerunning every deterministic lint/format/commitlint job weekly, which would add runner cost without benefit.
nodes.norm_label: use quality.yml for free local and github-native checks

nodes.label: Enforce Coverage Without Unsupported Action Inputs
nodes.rationale: davelosert/vitest-coverage-report-action@v2 does not define min-coverage-overall/min-coverage-changed-files inputs, so Vitest v8 provider thresholds (80% overall) plus a local changed-file coverage script enforce the gate; Vitest perFile thresholds were rejected as stricter than needed and able to block PRs over unrelated legacy files.
nodes.norm_label: enforce coverage without unsupported action inputs

nodes.label: Isolate Scorecard Permissions
nodes.rationale: A job-level permission override adds id-token: write and security-events: write scoped only to the Scorecard job, since publish_results: true requires id-token: write; setting publish_results: false was rejected because it does not satisfy the requested publishing behavior.

nodes.label: Upload SARIF to GitHub Code Scanning
nodes.rationale: Semgrep OSS runs without SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN and without Semgrep Cloud upload; both Semgrep and Scorecard produce SARIF uploaded via github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3 so results appear in the GitHub Security tab without paid services.
nodes.norm_label: upload sarif to github code scanning

nodes.label: digest.js / buildDigest deterministic repo walk
nodes.rationale: Deterministic structural walk, not a parser/AST or LLM scrape; zero-dependency, fast, explainable, reproducible in self-test. TypeScript compiler API/AST rejected as heavy/overkill; provider-reads-files-directly rejected as the grounding source (non-deterministic, unverifiable) though it may enrich story prose later.

nodes.label: stories.js / user stories artifact generation
nodes.rationale: Stories are a first-class artifact with provenance: each story cites the files it came from so the user can trust/verify it.

nodes.label: import --analyze flag / .powercodex/digest.json
nodes.rationale: Digest is read-only and additive: --analyze only writes .powercodex/digest.json; default import behaviour is unchanged. Safe to run on any existing repo; backward compatible.

nodes.label: mvp.js / proposeMvp digest-grounded MVP
nodes.rationale: MVP accepts a digest, falls back to goal: proposeMvp(root, { goal, digest }) draws surfaces from real routes/components when a digest exists, otherwise uses the keyword path. Backward compatible, no regression for greenfield.

nodes.label: compliance.js scoring (stories grounding, MVP-vs-stories)
nodes.rationale: Compliance gains two dimensions (scoreStoriesGrounding, scoreMvpAgainstStories); reuses the existing explainable keyword approach.

nodes.label: loop.js honouring frozen status
nodes.rationale: Freeze is an explicit status the loop honours; loop.js reads frozen artifacts but never regenerates them. Enforces the 'saved and never touched again until needed' requirement as state, not convention.

nodes.label: templates/starter/tools/lifecycle parity requirement
nodes.rationale: Template drift between tools/lifecycle/ and templates/starter/tools/lifecycle/ mitigated by a parity task step and a verify step that diffs the two trees.
